## Example 7.3 · (a) {#iv7-example-7-3-a .vector-lesson .projection-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>Consider the vectors <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=2\underset{\sim}{i}-5\underset{\sim}{j}"></span> and <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=-2\underset{\sim}{i}+3\underset{\sim}{j}"></span>.</p><p>a) Find the scalar projection of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}"></span> onto <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=2(-2)+(-5)(3)=-19"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle |\underset{\sim}{b}|=\sqrt{(-2)^2+3^2}=\sqrt{13}"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \frac{\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}}{|\underset{\sim}{b}|}=-\frac{19}{\sqrt{13}}"></span></div></div></div>
```


<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Section 7 · p. 55</div>
